captured.method: project-level <repo>/.agents/hooks.json (named groups s0-capture, s0-deny) in a scratch git repo; user ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json (symlink into dotfile) NOT touched; agy -p ... --dangerously-skip-permissions --output-format stream-json; 2 paid runs (A capture, B deny)

note_event_name: payload carries NO event-name field; the event is known only from which registration fired

SessionStart.fires_for: main conversation and again for each subagent conversation (new conversationId) before its first invocation

PostToolUse.note: invoke_subagent PostToolUse fires immediately (dispatch is asynchronous), before the subagent's SessionStart/tools

send_message.note: used by the subagent to report back to main

equalities.conversationId_main_vs_subagent: NOT equal: the subagent runs in its own conversation with a different conversationId on every hook event
equalities.parent_link: none: no parent id / agent name / role field in any payload; the subagent conversation id is not in the invoke_subagent payload
equalities.stepIdx: per-conversation counter (small ints), equal values appear in main and subagent - not an identifier

deny.model_sees: tool call denied by pre-tool hook: <reason>

facts.main_vs_subagent_distinguishable: yes by conversationId: first SessionStart-seen conversation is main; a conversationId first seen after an invoke_subagent PreToolUse is a subagent; role name is NOT available
facts.stop_event: exists (terminationReason e.g. NO_TOOL_CALL per docs, fullyIdle bool); block/continue is documented via Stop/PostInvocation output (terminationBehavior force_continue) - not exercised
facts.sub_invocation_turn_boundary: adapt_agy treats invocationNum 0 as a turn start; a subagent conversation also emits PreInvocation, so its turn ids come from its own conversationId
facts.hook_location: <workspace>/.agents/hooks.json is loaded in addition to user hooks.json
